key_facts.goal: Find indices of two numbers in the array that add up to a given target.
key_facts.input: An array of integers and an integer target.
key_facts.output: The indices of the two numbers (order doesn't matter), assuming exactly one solution.
key_facts.constraint: Each input has exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice.

key_facts.goal: Reverse a singly linked list.
key_facts.input: The head node of a singly linked list.
key_facts.output: The head node of the reversed list.
key_facts.constraint: Should be done by relinking pointers in-place, typically O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

key_facts.goal: Determine if a string of brackets is validly matched and nested.
key_facts.input: A string containing only the characters (, ), {, }, [, ].
key_facts.output: true if every bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order, false otherwise.
key_facts.constraint: An empty string is considered valid.

key_facts.goal: Merge two sorted linked lists into one sorted linked list.
key_facts.input: The heads of two sorted linked lists.
key_facts.output: The head of a single merged sorted linked list.
key_facts.constraint: The merge should splice the existing nodes together, not create new ones.

key_facts.goal: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum.
key_facts.input: An array of integers (can include negative numbers).
key_facts.output: The sum of the maximum contiguous subarray.
key_facts.constraint: The array contains at least one number, so a valid subarray always exists.

key_facts.goal: Count the distinct ways to climb to the top of a staircase of n steps, taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.
key_facts.input: An integer n, the total number of steps.
key_facts.output: The number of distinct ways to reach the top.
key_facts.constraint: n is a positive integer.

problem_title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

key_facts.goal: Find the maximum profit from buying on one day and selling on a later day.
key_facts.input: An array of daily stock prices.
key_facts.output: The maximum achievable profit, or 0 if no profit is possible.
key_facts.constraint: You must buy before you sell — only one transaction is allowed.

key_facts.goal: Determine if any value appears at least twice in the array.
key_facts.input: An array of integers.
key_facts.output: true if any value appears more than once, false if all elements are distinct.
key_facts.constraint: The array can be of any length, including empty.

key_facts.goal: For each index, compute the product of all other elements in the array.
key_facts.input: An array of integers.
key_facts.output: A new array where each element is the product of all the original elements except itself.
key_facts.constraint: Must be solved without using the division operator.

key_facts.goal: Find the number of nodes along the longest path from root to a leaf.
key_facts.input: The root of a binary tree.
key_facts.output: An integer representing the maximum depth.
key_facts.constraint: An empty tree (null root) has depth 0.

key_facts.goal: Determine if one string is an anagram of another.
key_facts.input: Two strings, s and t.
key_facts.output: true if t is an anagram of s (same letters, same counts, any order), false otherwise.
key_facts.constraint: The check must account for exact character frequency, not just shared characters.

key_facts.goal: Find the index of a target value in a sorted array.
key_facts.input: A sorted array of integers and a target value.
key_facts.output: The index of the target if found, else -1.
key_facts.constraint: The array is sorted in ascending order and must be searched in O(log n) time.

key_facts.goal: Determine whether a linked list contains a cycle.
key_facts.input: The head of a linked list.
key_facts.output: true if a cycle exists (some node's next points back to an earlier node), false otherwise.
key_facts.constraint: Should be solvable in O(1) extra space, e.g. Floyd's cycle detection.

key_facts.goal: Produce the mirror image of a binary tree by swapping every left and right child.
key_facts.input: The root of a binary tree.
key_facts.output: The root of the inverted tree.
key_facts.constraint: The inversion happens in-place, recursively swapping children at every node.

key_facts.goal: Find the element that appears more than n/2 times in the array.
key_facts.input: An array of integers.
key_facts.output: The majority element.
key_facts.constraint: The array is guaranteed to always have a majority element.

key_facts.goal: Find the one missing number from a sequence of n distinct numbers taken from 0 to n.
key_facts.input: An array of n distinct numbers in the range [0, n].
key_facts.output: The single number in that range missing from the array.
key_facts.constraint: Exactly one number from the range is missing.

key_facts.goal: Move all zeroes in an array to the end while keeping the relative order of non-zero elements.
key_facts.input: An array of integers.
key_facts.output: The same array modified in-place with zeroes moved to the end.
key_facts.constraint: Must be done in-place without making a copy of the array.

key_facts.goal: Find the one element that appears exactly once while every other element appears exactly twice.
key_facts.input: An array of integers where every element appears twice except one.
key_facts.output: The single element that doesn't have a pair.
key_facts.constraint: Should run in linear time using only constant extra space.

key_facts.goal: Determine if a binary tree is a mirror of itself around its center.
key_facts.input: The root of a binary tree.
key_facts.output: true if the tree is symmetric, false otherwise.
key_facts.constraint: An empty tree is considered symmetric.

key_facts.goal: Determine if the tree has a root-to-leaf path whose values sum to a given target.
key_facts.input: The root of a binary tree and a target sum.
key_facts.output: true if such a root-to-leaf path exists, false otherwise.
key_facts.constraint: The path must end at a leaf node (no children), not any node.
